page.layout: One printed page with a running head at the top and page number at the top right; one text column of running text; a faint fragment of a left-hand margin with a few cut-off notes at the far left edge, illegible. The digitiser's banner at the foot is not transcribed.

main_text.p: pertusus sit rimâ, deligenter explorare, quæ si nulla pateat supernè, væ tibi Bacche, si effluis infernè, sustine, inquam, frænos injice ponderi tuo, non discede de stationė; si vero vel tantilla rimula detecta sit, eja! jam integrum est erumpere, &, ni cantharus adsit, qui te maturè excipiat, pessum ire potes, & in cellæ pavimento, ut Liber es, liberè volutari. Interea exercet Aërem jus quoddam rigidum, & (audeo dicere) iniquum: hic enim genio suo indulgente Baccho, & infrâ per apertum Syphunculum dilabente, genium suum defraudare cogitur, descendere, in-

page.notes: The first line of the text is partly obscured at the left edge; the faint marginal fragments at the far left are cut off and illegible. Words such as "pertusus" and "stationė" are copied as printed. The line "re, in-" is set flush right and continues onto the next page.
